cells.gaps: No source found says a law, decree, regulation or circular requires public bodies to use the standards.
cells.note: NITA-U's e-GIF-2026 sets data-sharing standards such as DCAT and ODRL for all ministries, agencies and local governments (UGA-001). It calls itself mandatory, which the ladder does not count, so stage 4 waits on an instrument making it so.
